from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """A single cash reporting event extracted from one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company or entity reported in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="Exact label of the balance sheet line item (e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents', 'Cash')")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value as explicitly written in the document")
    amount_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date or range covered by the report")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from the document containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
